AUTHOR: Connolly
TITLE: Fish surveys on the move: Adapting automated fish detection and classification frameworks for videos on a remotely operated vehicle in shallow marine waters
REGION: Tallebudgera estuary, southeast Queensland, Australia (mixed reef and seagrass, 3 m depth)
SPECIES: luderick (Girella tricuspidata), yellowfin bream (Acanthopagrus australis); incidental Gerres subfasciatus and Ambassis marianus annotations in training only
DATA: Own underwater drone (QYSea FiFish V6) videos: 3 surveys x 3 days, 237 snippets, 11,714 annotations; dataset released via GitHub repository
V_EV: Methods: 'except for one survey cut short by an increase in turbidity that reduced visibility'; 'in 3 m water depth'; Fig. 3 'Distribution of blurriness values ... Low Laplacian variance values are indicative of high blurriness.'
D2: 2 survey days train (8,282 annotations) / 1 day test (3,432 annotations; 1,939 frames, 84 snippets); evaluation subset held out from training
D_EV: Methods: 'the training dataset, using snippets from surveys on two of the three days, and 2) the testing dataset, using snippets from surveys on the remaining day.'
R_EV: Discussion: 'with imagery from consecutive days, and from a single estuary' ; 'our model would likely underperform in a novel dataset'
C_EV: Results: 'The best performance metrics occurred with Seq-NMS turned on prior to applying confidence thresholds and using three frames. A CT of 40%... maximised F1'
E_EV: Table 3 'MaxN per video results' with 'FN proportion of GT'; Methods: 'MaxN was calculated across 84 video snippets' against annotated ground truth of the same snippets
ARCH: Detectron Faster R-CNN (ResNet50), Detectron2 Faster R-CNN (ResNet50-FPN + RPN), YOLOv5x (CSP-Darknet53); Seq-NMS spatio-temporal filter
METR: per-frame precision/recall/F1, MaxN per video precision/recall/F1, FN proportion of GT, FP counts; blurriness (Laplacian variance) and box-size distributions for TP/FN/FP
NOTE: Split by survey day (2 train days / 1 test day) at a single ~1 ha estuarine site, so D_ALL = Y but R1 = N (no different site/season/camera). One survey was cut short by turbidity in the field; coded V_ALL = P rather than N because the paper reports depth and a quantitative blur metric (Laplacian variance, V5 = 기타) and compares blur across TP/FN/FP (descriptive, not a model, so V7 = N); a verifier may consider the turbidity cut-off as uncharacterised exclusion. PRE coded COCO (Detectron2, YOLOv5); Detectron Faster R-CNN was ImageNet1k pretrained. C4 = Y reflects explicit false-positive/false-negative error analysis (assumed definition). E4 = 둘 다: FN proportion of GT in Tables 2-3 and size-class (box-area) analysis of FNs in Fig. 4. NIMG null: only 1,939 test frames stated; training frame count not given.
